picks.rationale: Weave community publishing going live changes what a Figma user can reach for tomorrow, with five concrete built tools to try immediately.
picks.excerpt: Community publishing is now live for Figma's Weave tools. Figma highlights five standout community-built tools, from turning a moodboard into a realistic room mockup to previewing a nail set.

picks.rationale: A major point release of a free image/vector app that most designers already have installed — new AI models plus a scripting system is a workflow change, not a rehash.
picks.excerpt: Canva ships Affinity 3.3 as part of the Canva ProSuite: a major update to the free image editing and vector design app adding scores of features, new AI models, and a new scripting system.

picks.rationale: Editable, collaborative docs and slides inside the chat turns one-shot AI output into a working artifact — the deck-and-spec half of a designer's week.
picks.excerpt: Anthropic folds Cowork into the main Claude chat and introduces Claude Docs and Claude Slides — editable, collaborative artifacts that live inside the conversation instead of being one-shot outputs.

picks.rationale: Simulation setup by natural-language prompt inside Onshape pulls analysis back into the industrial designer's own CAD session instead of a specialist's queue.
picks.excerpt: SimScale's Engineering AI Agent lands inside Onshape, handling CAD prep, simulation setup, physics analysis and results review through natural-language prompts.

picks.rationale: A $149 add-on that gives Steam Frame color passthrough and tracked 3D HDR capture makes spatial prototyping and reference capture cheap enough to actually try.
picks.excerpt: The $149 Arcturus Vision Camera adds 6MP-per-eye color passthrough to Steam Frame and captures tracked 3D HDR video, opening a cheap capture path for spatial creators.
